# Nominal constructor overload separation

Original Java 8 compiler input has a class formal with a nominal upper bound,
a public constructor accepting that formal, and a private constructor accepting
an unrelated plain interface. The public constructor computes the interface
argument before its exact this call. Frozen direct, reflective and method-handle
observers verify reference identity, float raw bits, ordered failures and partial
final fields. Owned and dependency profiles check complete original entries and
metadata after every recovered source is compiled.
